definitions: Forming general principles or conclusions from particular instances.
Making a general statement or concept by inferring from specific cases.
Applying a conclusion or rule to a broader range of cases than those originally observed.
Speaking or writing in general terms rather than in specific details.
examples: He is generalizing from a few examples.
She was generalizing about all teenagers.
The study avoids generalizing too broadly.
They are generalizing their findings to a larger population.
